messages:
Priya Patel: Quick thread — drafting a compact customer-facing runbook for go-live priming that covers caching, batching, and streaming fallbacks. Goal: single-page checklist CS can hand to engineering + an async checklist for customers.
Mike Chen: love this. can we keep it to 3 action items for CS and 3 presets for ENG? :thumbsup:
Tom Alvarez: +1. Also include a minimal observability section (what signals to watch). Most customers just need simple thresholds to know when to escalate.
Priya Patel: agreed. sketching: 1) Prefill strategy (when to prefill, sample sizes) 2) Batching config (latency vs cost presets) 3) Streaming + fallback (stream off -> short polling) 4) Signals & playbook (metrics + escalation).
Lena Gomez: can you add the renewal-risk note? if usage drops during trial, CS should trigger a targeted priming. short snippet: "If session_count falls >30% day-over-day for 48h -> trigger re-priming email + 1:1"
Priya Patel: good call. also want a tiny config snippet customers can paste into their infra docs (non-prod first):
```
# prefill pseudo-config (suggested defaults)
prefill: true
mode: "staggered"  # options: immediate | staggered | steady
batch_window_ms: 150   # target batching window for reduced unit cost
max_batch_tokens: 2048
streaming: true
fallback: { type: "polling", interval_ms: 500 }
```
Mike Chen: perfect. For CS-facing checklist: 1) Verify model + version pinned 2) Confirm prefill prompt set + golden examples 3) Enable warm pools for first 72h
Tom Alvarez: Observability signal list (metrics names we recommend): `prefill.success_rate`, `kv_cache.hit_rate`, `avg_time_to_first_token_ms`, `batch_size_percentile_95`, `stream_disconnects_per_1k_requests`. Add run thresholds: if `prefill.success_rate` < 90% -> investigate prompt errors or rate limits.
Priya Patel: adding escalation playbook: step 1) attempt non-prod repro with same prompts step 2) check `kv_cache.hit_rate` < 50% -> confirm cache key schema step 3) if `avg_time_to_first_token_ms` > 800ms escalate to ENG oncall + attach sample trace.
Lena Gomez: can we include a short customer-facing paragraph to set expectations? something like: "We’ll prime the system with a small representative sample of your production prompts, keep a warm pool for critical paths, and fall back to short polling only if streaming degrades."
Priya Patel: yes. Also adding guidance for renewal signals capture: add a single question CS should ask during week 2: "Have you observed any drop in response quality or latency-sensitive errors?" mark as high-signal for renewal risk.
Mike Chen: who owns the engineering presets? Tom?
Tom Alvarez: I can own the ENG presets and a short troubleshooting appendix. Will draft a 1-page tech note with exact curl snippets and sample telemetry queries (Grafana/Prom).
Priya Patel: action items: @Tom draft tech note by EOD Friday; @Mike update customer checklist and hand to AE; Lena to add renewal triggers and email template. I will stitch everything into a single one-pager and link it in the CS playbook.
runbook-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/prefill-batching-streaming-onepager (access: cs-team, eng-oncall).
Lena Gomez: quick suggestion — add a tiny example of a degraded-stream message the customer might see and the recommended customer-facing line: "We're seeing intermittent streaming delays; we’ll switch to a short polling mode to keep responses stable while we investigate."
Priya Patel: nice. final question: do we want to keep quantization/quality tradeoff notes here or point to Optimize?
Tom Alvarez: point to Optimize for model/quantization recommendations. keep this runbook focused on ops patterns only.
Mike Chen: :thumbsup: That keeps it actionable for CS.
Priya Patel: thanks all — I’ll publish a draft in the CS drive and ping this channel when done. if anyone has short snippets to add (promql queries or curl examples) drop them here and I’ll include.
Tom Alvarez: dropping a PromQL sample for `avg_time_to_first_token_ms` (95th):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Priya Patel: adding that. publishing by EOD Friday as promised. :rocket:
